behavior: When a popup returns focus, it checks `finalFocus`, the trigger, the element that had focus before the popup opened, the parent popup and the focus history, in that order. When the open interaction type is `null`, the element that had focus before the popup opened comes before the trigger. The return skips detached targets and targets with the `hidden` attribute on themselves or an ancestor. It skips targets in the popup that closes and each closed popup below it, even while those popups stay mounted. This includes controls that a slot in an open shadow root projects into those popups. For a non-tabbable target, the return tries its first eligible tabbable descendant, or the target itself if it has none. When a target is in a closed popup above with a disabled focus manager, the return element of that popup replaces it, at any depth. Without this replacement, focus would stay in a popup that unmounts (`BUG-5519`). After a press on the backdrop in a browser without `preventScroll`, an eligible explicit `finalFocus` target still gets focus.
